subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: The tracker shall operate entirely from local files adjacent to a repo, requiring no network, no database server, and no external service at any point in any operation.
rationale: the stated constraint — "no db, no dependency, filesystem alongside a repo"; the RW-4 minimal form
fit_criterion: a full lifecycle (create → link → transition → search → close) completes with zero network syscalls and no service process
